import os, sys, time, json, tempfile, msvcrt

class TestLock:
    def __init__(self, p):
        self.p = p
        self.f = None
        
    def acquire(self):
        f = open(self.p, 'r+b' if os.path.exists(self.p) else 'w+b')
        f.seek(0, 2)
        if f.tell() < 1:
            f.write(b'0')
            f.flush()
        f.seek(0)
        msvcrt.locking(f.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        f.seek(1)
        f.truncate(1)
        data = {'pid': os.getpid(), 'time': time.time()}
        f.write(b'\n' + json.dumps(data).encode() + b'\n')
        f.flush()
        self.f = f
        
    def release(self):
        if self.f:
            self.f.seek(0)
            self.f.truncate(0)
            self.f.write(b'0\n')
            self.f.flush()
            self.f.seek(0)
            msvcrt.locking(self.f.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
            self.f.close()
            self.f = None

def read_lock(p):
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        try:
            raw = f.read()
        except PermissionError:
            f.seek(1)
            raw = f.read()
    raw = raw.strip()
    if raw.startswith(b'0'):
        raw = raw[1:].strip()
    return json.loads(raw) if raw else None

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as tf:
    p = tf.name

try:
    tl = TestLock(p)
    tl.acquire()
    info = read_lock(p)
    print('Read lock info while held:', info)
    tl.release()
    after = open(p, 'rb').read()
    print('After release content:', after)
finally:
    os.unlink(p)
